title: Periodic abstinence
back: Avoid coitus on days 10–17 (the fertile period around day-14 ovulation). Natural methods have few side effects but a high failure rate.

title: Kinds of IUD
back: Non-medicated | copper-releasing (Cu ions cut sperm motility) | hormone-releasing (hostile uterus and cervix).

title: Oral pills
back: Progestogen ± estrogen; inhibit ovulation and implantation, change cervical mucus. Saheli: once a week, non-steroidal (CDRI, Lucknow).

title: Emergency contraception
legend: agents = progestogens, progestogen–estrogen pills or IUDs
back: Used after rape or unprotected intercourse to prevent pregnancy.

title: Vasectomy vs tubectomy
back: Both are terminal (surgical) methods that block gamete transport; reversibility is very poor.

title: MTP rule (NCERT)
back: Legalised in India in 1971; safest in the first trimester. Dangers: quacks, female foeticide.

title: Triple H: STIs not fully curable
back: All other STIs are curable if detected early. Untreated STIs → PID, ectopic pregnancy, infertility.

title: IVF–ET
back: The test-tube baby programme: fertilisation in vitro, then embryo transfer.

title: ZIFT vs GIFT
back: ZIFT: fertilisation already done in the lab. GIFT: fertilisation happens inside the body; for a woman who cannot produce ova.

title: ICSI vs AI / IUI
back: ICSI for very low sperm count or motility; AI/IUI when the man cannot inseminate or has a low sperm count.
